caption: Armenia ❤️ Namibia: forest-window hugs, lake portraits, dune-studio handclasps and lagoon-lounge affection. Four fictional adult friends in AI fashion. Distant smoke and mushroom-shaped clouds are imaginary effects, not real events.
orderedVisualQa: Main reviewed all four ALT editor images and final row-major grid. Upload order matches scenes 2069,2070,2073,2074.

altChecks.alt: AI-generated fashion scene of four fictional adult women in a timber lounge with forest-facing windows. Two women share a supported hug while two others lean inward with outstretched hands. Red-blue-orange outfits, an ivory-and-plum dress and a cobalt outfit appear with varied boots or rainbow sandals and visible IA, agency and silent king arm motifs.

AI-generated lake-window portrait of four fictional adult women in a close affectionate cluster, with a braided woman at left, a blonde near the center and two dark-haired women to the right and behind. Red-blue-orange, apricot, ivory-blue and silver-navy garments frame shared hands and shoulder touches. A circular landscape tattoo is visible. Distant mushroom-shaped smoke is an imaginary effect, not a real event.

AI-generated fictional Namibia fashion editorial: four adult women share a back hug and handclasp around a pale daybed in a dune-window studio. Orange, ivory, graphite, ochre and teal tailoring pair with rainbow boots and stockings. RAZE and IA arm tattoos are visible. Distant mushroom-shaped smoke is imaginary, not a real event.

AI-generated fictional Namibia fashion editorial: four adult women lean together on a pink couch beside a lagoon window. One rests against her friend while another reaches toward her hand. Sea-green and aqua tailoring mix with two Namibia-flag outfits, rainbow hosiery and varied heels. An agency arm tattoo is visible.
